Trailer separates the pre-CTE FLT branch and CTE-corrected FLC branches; an FLC-named headerlet is not FLC image acquisition.

source_assets.conditioning: STScI ACS Data Handbook section3.4 documents amplifier gain conversion DN→electrons, RAW zero-placeholder ERR initialization, a simple conditional CCD noise estimate, bad-pixel flags, bias/overscan trimming, dark/flat/reference corrections and photometric-keyword lookup. Literal non-bias Eq1 σ_CCD=√[(SCI−bias)+σ_RN²] is a pipeline initialization model; the source prose calls σ_RN² read noise while header definitions give READNSE units electrons. No repair, Gaussian/Poisson distribution or measured covariance is imported. Already-expanded nonzero ERR is left by doNoise; unread acquired ERR values do not establish which initialization branch applied. Pre-SM4 constant-bias and post-SM4 bias-gradient cases are distinguished; the2004 exposure is not silently assigned post-SM4 electronics. FLT calibrated electrons and drizzled electrons/s are different products. Source describes divide by EXPTIME then multiply by PHOTFLAM for calibrated flux units, and requires a pixel-area correction for point-source photometry on flat-fielded images. Those documented operations are unexecuted and do not supply PSF/dust/lens-light/extraction likelihood or reference uncertainty.

limitations: Dataset baseline is one current archival H9Q/GO10158/F606W calibrated FLT plus associated headerlet/trailer, separate from native RAW counts, CTE-corrected FLC/drizzled products, other exposures/filters and the2010 author reduction. Acquired declared ERR payloads do not qualify actual error values or a physical likelihood.

Calibration gain/read-noise, photometric keywords and fit RMS/CRDER are conditioned provider metadata. Their uncertainty distributions, reference covariance, pixel/error covariance and cross-probe covariance remain unknown, not zero or Gaussian/Poisson. The documented simple noise formula is not accepted as a measured detector law.

SCI FK5 with GAIAeDR3 catalog-labelled WCS and older ERR/DQ WCS cards are preserved literally. Neither a frame conversion nor pixel alignment/misalignment, distortion-grid units/support, headerlet application or astrometric covariance is qualified.

The calibrated conversion and pixel-area requirement are documentation, not an executed extraction. PSF ensembles, masks/censoring, dust/lens-light treatment, Keck spectra/templates/aperture/seeing, radio time series/delay covariance and environment selection/sightlines/full joint likelihood remain unverified. Current2026 archive processing is not a reconstruction of the2010 paper data analysis.

Selected archive rows are PUBLIC under a separately checked general MAST policy with exceptions; author-product rights and specific documentation redistribution licences remain unverified. Unread or unacquired material is not proven absent.

SDSS legacy RUN5566/82N and reduced-release coordinates remain a separate observation lineage; no HST exposure, clock, electron units or noise model supplies the missing SDSS event/frame/readout/extraction bridge.
